# Vendored icon font

`fa-solid-subset.ttf` is a six-glyph subset of Font Awesome Free 6 Solid.

- Icons: Font Awesome Free, licensed CC BY 4.0
  (https://fontawesome.com/license/free). Attribution: Font Awesome by
  Fonticons, Inc. (https://fontawesome.com).
- The font file format is licensed SIL OFL 1.1.

Glyphs included and where Corky uses them:

| codepoint | name               | Corky use            |
|-----------|--------------------|----------------------|
| U+F019    | download           | home: load key       |
| U+F084    | key                | home: key generation |
| U+F7D9    | screwdriver-wrench | home: tools          |
| U+F013    | gear               | home: settings       |
| U+F011    | power-off          | settings: power off  |
| U+F05A    | circle-info        | settings: about      |

The subset was produced with fonttools from the upstream fa-solid-900.ttf.
No other glyphs are present.
